source.title: Towards Accelerating Training of Batch Normalization: A Manifold Perspective
source.authors: Ming-Yang Yi; Qi Meng; Wei Chen; Zhi-Ming Ma

record.file_problem: none; full paper text is supplied
record.tranche_reason: Compares Adam with SGD and reports held-out image-classification performance, testing the adaptive-optimizer version with a different optimization study context.
record.gate_note: The paper reports test accuracy for its own optimizer comparisons; the Adam and SGD results bear on V4. Its manifold-specific optimizer results do not directly test another listed version. Theoretical convergence results and cited prior-work findings are not separate empirical rows.
record.test_reason: The study directly compares held-out image-classification accuracy under Adam and momentum SGD with limited learning-rate tuning, testing V4. It is not an original source for V4.
record.authors_conclusion: The record broadly captures the authors' conclusion: PSI-manifold optimization resolves rescaling ambiguity, has theoretical convergence guarantees for PSI-GD/PSI-SGD, and empirically improves generalization and efficiency over the baselines. Their claim of consistent superiority is stronger than every table entry warrants: for example, regularized CIFAR-10 ResNet56 has SGD at 94.19%, above both proposed methods.
record.recipe_differences: Compares PSI-manifold optimizers with SGD, Adam, and SGDG; uses grid-searched learning rates for SGD and Adam, CIFAR runs of 200 epochs and ImageNet runs of 100 epochs. Reports no random-label training or test-error gap measurements.
record.method_sensitivity: Dataset and ResNet depth change whether Adam or SGD has higher ImageNet test accuracy; SGD is higher for all listed CIFAR models, while Adam is higher for two of three ImageNet models.

fits_no_version.finding: PSI-manifold optimizers generally improve held-out accuracy and optimization speed over the baselines; the toy experiment measures gradient-norm convergence.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Optimizing batch-normalized networks on the proposed PSI manifold can improve training efficiency and held-out accuracy.

record.peer_reviewed: Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2022)
record.problems: The study reports test accuracy rather than train/test error gaps. It does not report language benchmarks. The stated averages and standard deviations are across independent runs; the text does not give statistical tests for the Adam–SGD differences.
record.rows_left_out: The paper's PSI-SGD, PSI-SGDM, and SGDG test-accuracy results, including the regularizer results in Table 2, were not extracted as rows because these methods do not map to a claim version. Toy-example gradient-norm results in Figure 4 measure optimization convergence rather than a listed generalization version.

untested.parts: Random-label fitting and its coexistence with natural-label generalization.
Width sweeps beyond the interpolation threshold.
Convolutional versus fully connected architectures and learned local connectivity.

Language benchmarks, broader optimizer tuning, decoupled weight decay, switching optimizers, and the claim's equal-or-better-training-performance condition; supplied figure text does not establish the latter comparison.
Batch-size variation and remedies for large-batch penalties.
Dropout effects, small-data regimes, and joint removal of dropout and weight decay.
Magnitude-aware perturbation sharpness, generalization-gap correlations, and ranking against other measures.
Removal of memorized examples versus random removal.

missing.what: Add the eight regularized momentum-SGD versus Adam comparisons from Table 2. CIFAR-10 SGD/Adam accuracies by depth 20/32/44/56 are 92.35/90.89, 93.64/91.83, 93.74/91.85, 94.19/91.78; CIFAR-100 values are 68.62/65.66, 70.67/67.72, 71.31/68.24, 72.44/68.78. Preserve the reported standard deviations. The second dataset heading repeats CIFAR-10, but the caption and Appendix F.1 identify CIFAR-100. The declared omissions cover manifold-method results, not these baseline comparisons.
missing.locator: Appendix F.1, Table 2; hyperparameters in Appendix F.2, Table 3

record.verdict_notes: All extracted accuracy values and standard deviations agree with Table 1. Paired SGD/Adam rows describe the same comparison and are not independent evidence. Learning rates were searched over three values per baseline with fixed decay schedules; Adam's other parameters were fixed. No statistical tests of Adam–SGD differences are reported. Speculation about flatter minima does not measure V7.

versions.untested_parts: Random-label memorization and natural-label generalization coexistence.
Convolutional versus fully connected architecture comparisons.
Language benchmarks; broader tuning; decoupled weight decay; switching from Adam to SGD; word-level language models.
Magnitude-aware sharpness and other generalization measures.
